name: qahub
description: Claude writes Playwright tests while it builds your app and sends them to QA Hub. Needs a QA Hub API key.

api_key.title: QA Hub API key
api_key.description: From QA Hub → Plan & API keys. Stored in your system keychain, never in a file.

server.title: QA Hub address
server.description: Leave as is unless your company runs its own QA Hub.
